title: Bowling Alley Concessionaire (NAF)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR COMBAT COMMAND > FA4800  633 CONS PKP
description:
The Department of the Air Force (DAF) is seeking commercial sources to enter into a Concessionaire Agreement for the operation of food, beverage, and catering services inside the   Langley Lanes Bowling Center, located on Joint Base Langley-Eustis (JBLE), Virginia. 

 The selected Concessionaire shall furnish all management, labor, transportation, tools, and consumable supplies necessary to ensure continuous, reliable, and high-quality food and beverage operations for JBLE military personnel, families, and authorized installation patrons. 

 A site visit is tentatively scheduled for  Tuesday, December 1, 2026, at 2:00 PM EST (1400 )  at the Langley Lanes facility on Joint Base Langley-Eustis (JBLE). Those interested to attend must follow the specific base access instructions detailed in the attached Solicitation. 

 All prospective Concessionaire questions must be submitted in writing no later than  December 3, 2026, at 2:00 PM EST (1400)  , with formal Government responses scheduled to be provided by  December 10, 2026, at 4:00 PM EST (1600) . Please note that only one consolidated set of questions will be accepted per Concessionaire. If you must submit updates, please ensure your final transmission is a comprehensive, cumulative compilation of all your current and previous inquiries. 

 For complete details, submission instructions, and full requirements, please refer to the attached solicitation documents.
